content: Potifar pushe Joséma tson'cho
Ismaelitandeccu Joséma Egiptoni anga'fasi Egipto'su na'su faraónma shondo'su, Potifarja tisema chava. Tsa Potifar tsu na'su faraóni'ccu pporotsse ccutsu'su sundarondeccumbe capitán.
Tsa'ma Na'su Chiga Joséi'ccu can'jensi tisema chava'su Egipto'sumbe tsaoni can'jen'an'qque ñotsse'yi can'jen.
Nane tise na'suja Na'su Chiga Joséni can'jensi pa'cco José tson'cho ñotsse sombosi atte.
Tsa'caen attepa Joséma ñotsse in'jamba tisema fuite'suve tsomba tise tsa'o na'suve'qque tson. Tsa'o na'suve tsomba pa'cco tisu an'bian'choma tisenga antte cuintsu mandaye.

Tsa'caen Joséma tsa'o na'suve tsomba pa'cco tisu an'bian'choma tisenga anttesi tsequi a'ta Na'su Chiga'qque Potifarma ñotsse tsoñe ashaen. Nane tise tsa'o'su, tise nasipa'suma'qque ñotsse tsoñe ashaen.
José tsa'caen pa'cco tise'bema ñotsse manda'jesi Potifarja jo'su añeñi jipa an'jen. Joséja quinsetssipa me'detssia a'i.
Tsa'caen bo'tsse can'jensi tise na'su pushe tisema camba in'jan. In'jamba fae a'ta tisema su: —Ñai'ccu ccuija.
Tsa'ma Joséja in'jambipa qquen su: —Que canjan, ña na'su tsu pa'cco tise an'bian'choma ñanga antte tsama ña coiraye. Ña vani can'jensi tiseja jongoesuve asi'ttaemba manda'jembi.

Va tsaonijan majañi'qque me'i'on tsu ña'can'me. Ña na'suja jongoesuveyi'qque ñama se'pimbi. Aqquia queveyi tsu ñanga afembi queja tise pushesi. Tsa'cansi, ¿ma'caen gi oshaya quema egae tsomba Chiganga'qque egae tsoñe?
Tsa'caen su'ni'qque toya tsu tsa pushesuja poi a'ta tisema ti'tsse noñangian cuintsu tisei'ccu ccuiye. Tsa'ma Joséja tise su'choma pañambi ni tisei'ccu pporotsse can'jembi.
Tsa'ma fae a'ta, a'i me'i'ani, Joséja cuartonga ca'ni tseccuni semañe.
Ca'nisi Potifar pusheja tise omba'su ondiccu'jeye qquitssa indipa su: —Ñai'ccu ccuija. Tsa'ma Joséja dyopa tise omba'su ondiccu'jema pushesunga oshichha catipa butto somboin ja.
Tsa'caen tise tivenga tsa ondiccu'jema cati jasi attepa

pushesuja tisu etti'su semasundeccuma ttu'sepa su: —Que can'faja, ña tsa'ndu va hebreo'su a'ima isi ja'ño ingima tsu noñangiañe ashaen. Nane ñaccuni ca'nimba ñai'ccu ccuiye in'jansi gi quian'me fundo.
Quian'me pa'cco tsain'fai'ccu ña fundosi pañamba tsu tise sarupama cati somboin ja.
Tsomba José ondiccu'jema ñoñamba an'bian tisu tsa'ndu tsaoni jiya'ngae.
Tise jisi o'tie condaqquia'caeñi condapa su: —Tsa hebreo'su a'ima sema'suve que i'cho tsu ñaccuni ca'nimba ñai'ccu ccuipa egae tsoñe in'jan.
Tsa'ma pa'cco tsain'fai'ccu ña fundosi tsu tise sarupama cati butto somboin ja. Tsa'caen tsu que i'cho sema'suja ñama tsincon.
Tise pushe tsa'caen condase'jesi pañamba Joséma ambian'su na'suja ñoa'me iyicca'ye.
Iyicca'yepa Joséma qquitssa indipa cca'ima manda cuintsu picco'je'cho ettinga picco'faye, na'su faraónga indiyepa dyai'jeccuni. Tsa'ma picco'jeccuni can'jen'ni'qque
Na'su Chigaja Joséi'ccu can'jemba tisu ñotsse tsoña'chove canjaen'jen. Nane cuintsu picco'jeccuni'su na'su Joséma ñotsse in'jaña'chove Chigaja antte.
Tsa'caen anttesi picco'jeccuni'su na'suja pa'cco indiye'chondeccuma Josénga antte cuintsu camba coira'jeye. Nane José tsu pa'cco tseccuni'suma manda'suve da.
José ñotsse mandasi indiyeccuni'su na'suja jongoesuve iñajampañambi Na'su Chiga Joséi'ccu can'jensi ñotsse tsu somboya qquen in'jamba.
